Changes to Jupiter Asset Management's Small and Mid-Cap Investment Team

The Board of Rights and Issues Investment Trust PLC notes the announcement issued today by Jupiter Asset Management setting out personnel changes in its Small and Mid-Cap investment team and, specifically, the departure in early 2027 of Matt Cable and Tim Service, the Company's investment managers.
In light of the above the Board intends to review its options in respect of the management of the Company's assets.
Andrew Worne / Tunga Chigovanyika - Corporate Finance
